title: CDC - Preventing Chronic Disease: Review a Manuscript
content: Review a Manuscript Print Minus Related Pages Peer reviewers for Preventing Chronic Disease (PCD) evaluate manuscripts using ScholarOne Manuscripts . ScholarOne Manuscripts is a manuscript tracking system that allows authors to submit manuscripts and reviewers to evaluate manuscripts electronically. All PCD manuscripts are submitted and reviewed through this system. Reviewers log in to the system, read their assigned manuscripts, offer comments separately to authors and journal editors, and complete brief score sheets that include recommendations on whether or not to publish. If you have been selected to review a manuscript, please click here . If you are interested in reviewing articles on any topic related to preventing chronic disease, please read our Call for Peer Reviewers . Peer reviewers selected to review a manuscript receive an e-mail confirmation, which includes a ScholarOne Manuscripts log-in ID and password. More instructions on reviewing manuscripts through ScholarOne Manuscripts may be found at http://mc.manuscriptcentral.com/pcd . The opinions expressed by authors contributing to this journal do not necessarily reflect the opinions of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, the Public Health Service, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, or the authors’ affiliated institutions. Last Reviewed: September 15, 2022 Source: National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion
